title: Wedding SVG Bundle, 20
author: Extreme DesignArt
description:
This is Wedding SVG Bundle, 20 designs can be used For various purposes❤️
|| you will receive the design file in a ZIP folder ||
The design comes in the following formats:
➪ SVG file: compatible with Cricut cutting machine, Silhouette Cameo (the Designer Edition) etc.
➪ PNG file with transparent background.
➪ EPS file: compatible with Adobe Illustrator and CorelDraw.
➪ DXF file: compatible with Silhouette Studio (including the basic version).
—————————————-
Bundle included Design Text:
– And they lived happily ever after SVG
– Mother of the bride SVG
– Mother of the groom SVG
– Welcome to our beginning SVG
– Besties of the bride SVG
– I’d crew SVG
– Welcome to our love story SVG
– Welcome to our celebration SVG
– True love is the greatest adventure SVG
– Best wishes for the mr & mrs SVG
– Love is sweet please take a treat SVG
– Future bride SVG
– Has anyone seen the rings SVG
– Husband and wife best friends for life SVG
– Best friends for life husband and wife SVG
– Happiness is being married to your best friend SVG
– Romance is the icing, but love is the cake SVG
– A happy marriage is the union of two good forgivers SVG
– Let your brotherly love continue SVG
– We loved with a love that was more than love SVG
>>>USE<<<
This design is perfect for – SVG cut products, cards, frame artwork, scrapbooks, t-shirts, pillows, bags, mugs stickers and much more.
You can also use the design with your Cricut and Silhouette cutting machines.
Thank you!
